title: SpaceX, Musk pledge to donate a share each to active Trump Accounts
summary_full: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.
summary_public: SpaceX said it will donate one share of the company's class A stock to every active Trump Account, and CEO Elon Musk would match it.
